family.description: The DASH complex is a ~10 subunit microtubule-binding complex that is transferred to the kinetochore prior to mitosis [[cite:PUB00017174]]. In Saccharomyces cerevisiae DASH forms both rings and spiral structures on microtubules in vitro [[cite:PUB00033281],[cite:PUB00033282]]. This family also includes several higher eukaryotic proteins. However, other DASH subunits do not appear to be conserved in higher eukaryotes.
family.name: DASH complex subunit Hsk3 like
